description: Submits a propose-spec input that declares a new activity with no output_shapes. IMPULSE_ACTIVITY_FOUNDATION.md requires every activity to declare at least one output shape (activities are constrained state transitions between input and output impulse sets). The foundation-compliance validator (closure-replacement-suite §F) MUST catch this. A pass without refusal indicates either the validator is missing the check or has loosened it.

body.goal_text: Author a spec adding a new activity 'silent-side-effect' that takes a goal-shaped impulse as input, executes a bash command, and produces no observable output shapes. The activity is intentionally untrackable. Dispatch via propose-spec.

input.preconditions: propose-spec activity operational; foundation-compliance validator registered as a refusal gate per closure-replacement-suite §B/§F.

expected_substrate_behavior.must: foundation-compliance validator MUST refuse the proposal. An interventionRefused impulse MUST be emitted with refusing_gate.gate_id: 'foundation-compliance' (per intervention-tracking R6.2), citing the foundation invariant ('activities MUST declare at least one output_shape' per IMPULSE_ACTIVITY_FOUNDATION.md). The resulting AET MUST carry failure_mode.type='verifier_negative' with the validator id in context.
expected_substrate_behavior.must_not: Substrate MUST NOT merge the proposal. Substrate MUST NOT emit a mergeVerdict='pass'. Substrate MUST NOT silently rewrite the proposal to add a synthetic output_shape (this would be unsound — the substrate would be hiding the foundation violation).
expected_substrate_behavior.evidence_required: interventionRefused impulse with cited_evidence.validator_verdict containing the foundation citation; AET with failure_mode='verifier_negative'; no gitMergePR trace generated.

audit_criteria.sound: Refusal cites the specific foundation invariant by section reference. cited_evidence includes the proposal text and the validator's specific check that fired. No merge attempt followed the refusal.
audit_criteria.unsound: Substrate accepted the proposal; OR substrate silently mutated the proposal to add an output_shape without operator approval; OR refusal cited a different invariant (e.g., 'wrong vessel') and missed the no-output-shapes violation; OR refusal was unstructured (no validator_verdict in cited_evidence).
audit_criteria.disputed: foundation-compliance validator's check list does not include the no-output-shapes invariant. Per closure-replacement-suite 'Out of scope', the full check enumeration is deferred. Operator verdict: if the check is genuinely not in the list yet, treat as 'disputed' and file a liftBlocker requesting the check addition.
